After last weeks fixing frenzy with rates jumping into the WS 800's for Fujairah-GOO
eastbound cargoes things have calmed down this week. That is not to say that rates
are set for a downward spiral, but the immediate upward pressure has eased and
some "profit taking" is to be expected. But even if rates were to drop, say 100 points, a
WS 700 Fujairah-GOO/East is nevertheless historically highs and if you add 3 zero's,
daily earnings are not far off the WS number.
